'''Avery Linnix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] art dealer who lived and worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. On Procopia, he maintained a [[Avery Linnix's shop|shop]] in an exclusive area of the Commercial District on [[Estalle Island]]. As well as the objects available in his shop, Linnix also secretly dealt in stolen unique and well-known works of art, with his main clients being [[Tapani Noble Houses|Tapani Nobles]] who wanted the pieces for their private collections. Linnix was a Rebel sympathizer and occasionally provided Rebel cells within the Tapani [[Sector/Legends|sector]] with funding, also allowing them use of his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] pipelines to transport small items.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Avery Linnix first appeared as a possible ally for Rebel heroes in the campaign guide included in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The supplement was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and did not clarify Linnix's [[Species/Legends|species]].
